projects.title: City Medical Center
projects.summary: City Medical Center's brand identity design is a cohesive, modern visual system built around the core themes of continuity, trust, and compassionate care. By translating a multifaceted healthcare model into a clean, approachable, and scalable identity—featuring soothing medical teal tones, clean typography, and empathetic iconography—the branding successfully positions the center as a lifelong partner in health and a leader in modern medical excellence.

projects.title: Midad Jewlry
projects.summary: Midad Jewelry is a Qatari jewelry brand rooted in storytelling, heritage, and emotional resonance.   Each collection is a poetic expression—whether through the romanticism of “Hob Horoof”, the joy of “Bahja”, or the elegance of “Luxury by Midad”. The brand’s essence lies in the phrase:   “A unique story with every piece.” "قصة مميزة مع كل قطعة"   This reflects a commitment to personal meaning, cultural pride, and timeless artistry.

projects.title: Siket Training Center
projects.summary: The SIKET Training Center brand identity employs a modern and professional design to position the institution as a strategic partner in growth. The primary logo creatively forms an abstract "S" with an integrated graduation cap, symbolizing the brand's commitment to transforming ambitious individuals into industry-specific leaders. A cohesive color palette of deep greens and light greens, with occasional yellow accents, projects a reliable yet innovative energy across all applications, including corporate stationery, marketing posters, and digital platforms. Complementing the visual identity is powerful, forward-thinking messaging like "Unlock Your Potential, Master Your Future," ensuring the brand resonates with its audience across physical and online educational environments.

projects.title: TPlink: packaging
projects.summary: Designed for TLM International as an authorized regional distributor, this advanced packaging dieline and visual layout for the TP-Link BE9300 Tri-Band Wi-Fi 7 Router merges high-performance aesthetics with strict technical compliance. The project features a sleek, dark-themed tech-forward color palette optimized for retail visibility, expertly structuring complex hardware specifications, multi-gigabit port breakdowns, and next-generation Wi-Fi 7 capabilities. Through meticulous dieline engineering, precise icon adaptation, and seamless integration of TLM branding with TP-Link's global identity, the packaging delivers a flawless print-ready production standard that enhances retail shelf impact across international markets.

projects.title: Tplink: packaging white
projects.summary: Designed for TLM International as an approved regional distributor, this packaging solution for the TP-Link Archer AX55 Wi-Fi 6 Router balances corporate brand harmonization with localized retail appeal. The project involved engineering a precise, print-ready dieline and visual layout that seamlessly integrates TLM International’s distributor branding alongside TP-Link’s established global visual identity, color scheme, and typography hierarchy. By structuring critical technical specifications, compliance marks, and core product features into a clean, intuitive layout, the packaging ensures strong shelf impact, retail clarity, and flawless execution across international markets.

projects.title: UI/UX Design | Fintech | Arifpay
projects.summary: Arifpay is a comprehensive Ethiopian fintech platform that consolidates local payment options—including Telebirr, CBE Birr, M-Pesa, and bank cards—into one powerful ecosystem. Built for total everyday utility, it empowers users to seamlessly settle utility bills, buy mobile airtime top-ups, and process merchant transactions through a single unified interface across Android, iOS, and Web.

projects.title: UI/UX designs | productivity | Veloa
projects.summary: Veloa is a Windows desktop operating system that unifies goals, schedules, notes, music, and an AI coach into a single, dark-themed workspace connecting long-term ambitions to daily tasks. Featuring a calm visual hierarchy with a black canvas, white text, and yellow action accents, the app provides nine core tabs—including a priority Dashboard, a timeline Schedule, and a four-level hierarchical Goals tree tracking progress and pace—all supported by desktop widgets and offline-first Markdown notes.

projects.title: UI/UX Design | Fintech | Xidex
projects.summary: Xidex is a payment gateway that unifies local wallets like Telebirr, CBE Birr, M-Pesa, and cards into a single API and fast checkout page. Wrapped in a bold lime and black identity, it offers a merchant mobile app, secure customer checkout, and a full admin console across Android, Windows, and Web.

projects.title: Qatar Airways Exhibition Booth: 3D Visualization
projects.summary: This 3D exhibition booth concept presents a flagship mega-activation designed in Cinema 4D for Qatar Airways, spanning an expansive total area of 600 square meters (20m × 30m) to accommodate large-scale international trade shows. Masterfully rendered in signature Qatar Airways maroon and polished gold accents under sweeping overhead trussing and suspended branding, the design is built on a fully modular framework. This structural flexibility allows the layout to operate as a unified, high-density pavilion or be broken down into five standalone, independently deployable sub-booths for smaller venue footprints.

about.title: about.
about.lead: I'm a Senior graphic designer | UI/UX & Product Designer | Video Editor
about.text: I am a multidisciplinary creator with over 14 years of experience bridging the gap between rigorous technical systems and intuitive design. Specializing in branding, UI/UX systems, and front-end execution, I thrive in fast-paced environments where creativity meets engineering. I use strategic problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking to turn complex user challenges into clean, engaging, and high-impact digital realities.

facts.title: Random facts
items: Fact 1:Rooted in Code, Driven by Art: Holding a Bachelor’s in Computer Science from Jimma University, I approach UI/UX design with a deep, structural understanding of how applications are built under the hood.

Fact 2:Global Perspective: Having worked across East Africa and the Middle East (including major projects in Doha, Qatar), I love adapting creative campaigns to diverse cultural landscapes and fast-moving markets.

rows.title: My story
rows.text:
From Computer Science Roots to Creative Execution

My career journey began at the intersection of logic and structure with a degree in Computer Science. Realizing my passion for visual communication and human-computer interaction, I transitioned into professional design and media production. Over the last 14+ years, I’ve grown from an IT and systems administrator into a Senior UI/UX and Product Designer. Today, I combine my technical coding capabilities with advanced motion arts and branding strategies to deliver seamless, scalable, and visually compelling digital experiences.

rows.title: My Services & Who I Work With
rows.text:
What I Offer:
I deliver end-to-end digital solutions by bridging UI/UX design, motion graphics, and front-end execution. My primary services include:   
UI/UX & Product Design: Building mobile-first interfaces, intuitive user flows, and scalable Figma design systems for fintech, Web apps, and digital platforms.  

 Brand Identity & 3D Visualizations: Crafting complete corporate brand identities, packaging dielines, and photorealistic 3D product renders using Cinema 4D and Blender.   

Full STack Development: Translating visual concepts into clean, functional web applications utilizing HTML/CSS, JavaScript, React, and WordPress.   

Motion Graphics & Content Production: Designing animated explainers, promo reels, and interactive walkthroughs with After Effects and Premiere Pro.
